title: Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarial red-teaming and automated testing using GPT-4 to simulate multi-turn conversations aimed at inducing biased or harmful responses as part of Microsoft's internal Responsible AI (RAI) evaluation.
Quantitative assessment of the multi-modal model using the public VLGuard benchmark and internal multi-modal RAI benchmarks, complemented by human evaluation conducted by an internal red team.
